name: 78945 · La Grange, TX
findings: ZIP 78945 (La Grange) has 60 nonprofit organizations. 30 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 26 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (44% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78945 (La Grange) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
40% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 78945 (La Grange) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).
